description: Every approval decision goes through the one gate registry, bin/lib/gates.ts runGate / declineGate (PRD §7.20): it owns what --yolo may skip, what a run without a terminal does, and each gate's exit code. Only gates.ts and the content-question verbs (bin/cli/sketch.ts, and bin/cli/intake.ts for the PRD §7.1 battery, the pasted assignment and the follow-ups — GRND-02) may import ask() from bin/lib/prompts.ts, and only bin/lib/prompts.ts and bin/lib/prompts/ may load @clack/prompts. A verb that asks on its own would re-grow a private --yolo and no-terminal policy (the three ApprovalUnavailableError copies this row replaced).
